## Import

```tsx
import { TOAST_DEFAULT_DURATION, TOAST_MAX_VISIBLE, useToast } from '@beemvp/beeui-ui';
```

There is no documented deep/private source import. For source ownership from a BeeUI checkout:

```bash
pnpm beeui add toast
```

## State and behavior contract

Provider-scoped imperative API (`useToast().show`/`dismiss`/`dismissAll`) rather than a controlled component; toasts queue FIFO with at most three visible at once, an explicit persistent mode opts a toast out of auto-dismiss, and action-triggered dismissal is deterministic (never racing the auto-dismiss timer).

### Props

_This family exports no `*Props` type._

**Related exported types:**

- `ToastAction` — alias of `{ label: string; onPress: () => void; /** Dismisses after the callback by default. Set false for an explicit persistent action. */ dismissOnPress?: boolean; }`.
- `ToastApi` — alias of `{ show: (options: ToastOptions) => ToastId; dismiss: (id: ToastId) => void; dismissAll: () => void; }`.
- `ToastDuration` — alias of `number | 'persistent'`.
- `ToastId` — alias of `string`.
- `ToastOptions` — alias of `{ title: string; description?: string; variant?: ToastVariant; duration?: ToastDuration; action?: ToastAction; }`.
- `ToastVariant` — one of `'neutral'`, `'success'`, `'warning'`, `'destructive'`, `'info'`.

The executable fixtures below are the source-grounded usage examples; consumers should not infer state ownership from DOM structure or another UI library.

## Provider and dependencies

- `BeeUIProvider` is required above this family because it participates in shared overlay/toast runtime infrastructure.
- **Peer/native dependencies visible to this Registry item:** `react`, `react-native`, `react-native-safe-area-context`
- **Registry dependency closure:** `text`, `theme`
- Safe-area ownership remains explicit: shell surfaces touching system edges opt into `SafeArea`; components do not silently invent app-shell insets.
- Web consumers load the BeeUI semantic theme CSS as documented in [Web onboarding](/docs/start/web/).

## Styling and theming

BeeUI components consume semantic tokens and support the current typed variant/density contracts. Use [Theming](/docs/theming/) and [Density](/docs/guides/density/). `className` is an implementation escape hatch for source-owned/application work, not a cross-engine portability guarantee.
